signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: No password. We email you a link that signs you in. New here? Signing in creates your account.
signIn.checkBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.

errors.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.generic: Signing in didn't work. Please try again.

signIn.spamHint: Nothing there after a minute? Look in spam or promotions, or send the link again.
signIn.resent: Sent again. Use the newest link.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: To coach and test you, we store and use data about your health and training, such as heart rate, lab results and how you feel. We need your permission for that.
consent.healthData: I agree that my health and training data is processed for my coaching and testing.
consent.healthDataHint: Required to use your account. You can withdraw it at any time.
consent.marketing: Send me news and offers by email.
consent.marketingHint: Optional. You can unsubscribe at any time.
consent.required: Please agree to the processing of your health data to continue.
consent.error: Saving didn't work. Please try again.

panel.title: Your bookings and details in one place.

points.bookings: See your next test: when, where and how to prepare.
points.faster: Book faster, with your details already filled in.
points.data: Download or delete your data whenever you want.
